live_offline_banner: Offline: showing the last saved data.
search_placeholder: Search node by name or id
map_hint: Interactive map. The node list offers the same information in an accessible way.
map_no_tiles: Light and Dark show up once the area's base map is downloaded (panel: Site and map → Base map extract). Until then, satellite.
map_error: The map could not be loaded
legend_fill: The fill shows how recent a node is: full, active; three quarters, recent; half, late; empty, inactive.
legend_links: Lines: links between neighbors; solid, good signal; dashed, fair; dotted, weak.
map_fps_suggest: The map is struggling on this device. Solid mode removes transparency and makes it smoother.
node_not_found_detail: The node does not exist or the administrator hid it.
node_gateway_hint: Receives the mesh traffic and forwards it to the site. Signal is measured on the other nodes.
nodes_empty_hint: Try other filters or clear the search.
chat_readonly: Read only: messages arrive over the radio.
chat_search_empty: No matching messages among the loaded ones
chat_reacted: {name} reacted with {emoji} to an earlier message
push_description: Get notified when there is a public alert, such as a call for help (SOS).
push_denied: Notifications are blocked in this browser.
push_unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications.
push_ios_install: On iPhone, add the site to the home screen first.
push_error: The subscription could not be completed
push_unavailable: Notifications are not available right now.
stats_relays_hint: The firmware only reports the last byte of the relaying node; the possible candidates are shown.
about_what_body: A live map of the local Meshtastic network: nodes, public channel messages, alerts and statistics. A gateway receives what goes over the radio and meshbox publishes it.
about_software_author: Author: Marco Magnanelli with Claude Opus 5.5
about_software_body: meshbox is free software (Apache-2.0). The map uses MapLibre GL JS and the Protomaps base map with OpenStreetMap data.
error_rate_limited: Too many requests; retry in {seconds} s
not_found_body: The address does not match any page of the site.
update_available: A new version of the site is available
offline_ready: The site is now available offline
shortcut_close: Close the details or the dialog
admin_login_intro: Access to the meshbox administration panel.
admin_login_wait: Too many attempts; wait {seconds} s before retrying
admin_insecure: The panel uses HTTP on the local network. To manage it from outside, use the hostname protected by Cloudflare Access (HTTPS).
admin_must_change: The initial password must be changed before continuing.
admin_session_expired: The session expired; sign in again.
admin_shared_mode: Shared device: the WiFi network and the host name are not managed here.
admin_section_dashboard_desc: Service status, CPU, RAM, temperature, disk, packets per minute, connectors, live clients and version.
admin_section_radio_desc: MQTT and USB connectors: create, edit, restart, test, counters and recording.
admin_section_client_desc: The board as in the app: status, battery, messages, nodes, channels and settings, with a backup before every change.
admin_section_mqtt_desc: Accounts, current ACL, topic monitor and gateway commands.
admin_section_channels_desc: Name, key (write only) and whether the channel is public.
admin_section_packets_desc: Live and stored capture with filters, details and export.
admin_section_nodes_desc: Full table including hidden nodes: hide, mark as fixed, internal note and history deletion.
admin_section_messages_desc: Public chat moderation with audit log.
admin_section_alerts_desc: Rules, notification channels, tests, history and acknowledgement.
admin_section_site_desc: Name, logo, accent, layers, center and bounds, map extract, thresholds and privacy notice.
admin_section_privacy_desc: Ignore MQTT, precision policy, retention per table and purge.
admin_section_cloudflare_desc: Tunnel in token or API mode, status, hostnames and remote administration with Access.
admin_section_network_desc: WiFi, hotspot, hostname, time, services, metrics, restart and shutdown.
admin_section_plugins_desc: List, activation, settings and logs per plugin.
admin_section_users_desc: Users, roles, passwords, active sessions and audit log.
admin_section_updates_desc: Current version, available versions, install and roll back.
admin_section_logs_desc: Journal of each service with filters; meshbox's, live.
admin_section_tx_desc: Text and traceroute with the node connected over USB or the network (optional, disabled by default).
adm_shared_blocked: Not available on a shared device: network, Wi-Fi and hostname are managed by the host system (ADR 0004).
adm_rate_limited: Too many requests; try again in a moment.
adm_forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
adm_copy_failed: Could not copy; select the text manually.
adm_map_unavailable: The map is not available in this browser; type the values instead.
adm_place_search_error: Search failed (is there internet access?). You can move the map or type the coordinates.
adm_coord_hint: You can paste “latitude, longitude” copied from Google Maps into either field.
adm_map_use_view: Use the view's center and zoom
adm_map_use_box: Use the view as the box
adm_stale: Could not refresh; showing the last data
adm_restart_service_desc: The service stops for a few seconds and comes back on its own.
adm_restart_meshbox_desc: The site, the panel and packet reception stop for a few seconds. The page reconnects on its own.
adm_ppm_desc: Last hour, received by all connectors.
adm_live_clients_value: {public} on the site · {admin} in the panel
adm_no_gateways: No packet with a gateway has arrived yet.
adm_node_hidden_hint: It disappears from the public map, list and chat; its new packets are dropped.
adm_node_fixed_hint: Shown with a thin ring and included in “fixed nodes” alerts.
adm_internal_note_hint: Only visible in the panel (up to 500 characters).
adm_purge_desc: Deletes the node's positions, telemetry, messages, links, traceroutes and packets. For a full removal, also hide it.
adm_purge_confirm_desc: All its stored data is deleted. This cannot be undone.
adm_channels_intro: Only messages from a channel marked as public are stored and shown on the site. Private channels and direct messages are never published.
adm_channels_empty: No channels yet: without a public channel the site shows no messages.
adm_channel_public_hint: Its messages appear in the site chat.
adm_channel_name_hint: As in the Meshtastic app (up to 11 characters), for example MediumFast.
adm_channel_key_invalid: The key must be base64 (for example AQ==).
adm_channel_delete_desc: Its packets will no longer be decrypted. Stored messages remain.
adm_connectors_empty: No connectors: add one to receive packets.
adm_connector_id_hint: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (2 to 32). Cannot be changed later.
adm_connector_id_invalid: Invalid id: lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (2 to 32).
adm_connector_mqtt_help: Reads the MQTT broker where the gateway publishes (usually this device's Mosquitto).
adm_connector_serial_help: Node connected to this device over USB.
adm_connector_tcp_help: Node with Wi-Fi or Ethernet, through the Meshtastic TCP API (port 4403).
adm_connector_replay_help: Replays a JSONL recording (demos and tests).
adm_mqtt_tls_hint: Only for an external broker with a certificate.
adm_serial_port_hint: E.g. /dev/serial/by-id/… on the Pi or COM5 on Windows.
adm_recordings_desc: JSONL files in the recordings folder.
adm_replay_speed_hint: 1 = real time; 0 = as fast as possible.
adm_record_desc: Saves every raw packet to a JSONL file in the recordings folder (for replay or diagnosis).
adm_test_mqtt_ok: Connected in {ms} ms; {messages} messages arrived in {seconds} s ({valid} from Meshtastic).
adm_test_usb_ok: The node answered: see the node information.
adm_node_reboot_desc: The node reboots in 10 s and stops receiving while it starts.
adm_release_desc: Stops the connector so the Meshtastic CLI can use the node. To receive again, restart the connector.
adm_connector_delete_desc: It is stopped and removed from the configuration.
adm_mqtt_out_desc: Publishes nodes, messages, telemetry, positions and alerts as JSON for other systems.
adm_mqtt_accounts_desc: One per gateway (gw-), integration (int-) or debugging (dbg-). The password is generated and shown only once.
adm_mqtt_rotate_desc: The current password stops working: the new one has to be set on the device that uses this account.
adm_mqtt_rotate_ingest: meshbox reconnects by itself with the new password.
adm_mqtt_delete_desc: The device using it can no longer connect to the broker.
adm_mqtt_acl_desc: Per-account permissions that privd writes to /etc/mosquitto/acl.
adm_mqtt_monitor_hint: To watch the decoded live traffic:
adm_mqtt_name_invalid: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (2 to 28), starting with a letter or digit.
adm_mqtt_purpose_gateway_hint: The Heltec publishes under the topic root (read and write).
adm_mqtt_purpose_debug_hint: Reads the raw traffic from another machine (read only).
adm_mqtt_serial_hint: Only to build the example commands (COM5, /dev/ttyUSB0…).
adm_mqtt_secret_once: Copy the password now: it is not shown again. To see it again a new one has to be generated.
adm_mqtt_heltec_desc: With the Meshtastic CLI, from the PC with the Heltec connected over USB.
adm_mqtt_optional: Optional: only if the node does not relay
adm_pkt_text_hint: Source node name or packet id.
adm_rules_empty: No rules. The default ones (SOS, gateway without packets and system) are created at startup.
adm_rule_no_channels: The rule has no channels: nothing is sent.
adm_rule_delete_desc: Alerts already recorded stay in the history.
adm_cooldown_hint: Minimum time before notifying again for the same rule and node.
adm_rule_no_params: This type has no parameters: it notifies the first time each node is heard.
adm_rule_channels_hint: Channels are configured in the Notification channels tab.
adm_rule_public_hint: Shown on the site and sent to public subscriptions (for example SOS).
adm_rp_patterns_hint: One per entry (Enter to add). Default \bSOS\b.
adm_rp_bell_hint: The alert button of some apps sends the \x07 character.
adm_rp_nodes_hint: Id like !xxxxxxxx (only if the scope is “those in the list”).
adm_rp_duration_hint: Notifies only if the condition holds that long (0 = immediately).
adm_push_here_desc: Admin subscription: receives every alert, not only the public ones.
adm_push_unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications or the server has no VAPID keys.
adm_push_no_sw: The service worker is not active yet: reload the page and try again.
adm_push_denied: Notification permission is blocked in this browser.
adm_webpush_desc: Notifications on phones and computers (VAPID). On iPhone the PWA must be installed.
adm_telegram_desc: A Telegram bot writes to a chat or group.
adm_telegram_chat_hint: Number of the chat or group (can be negative).
adm_webhook_desc: JSON POST signed with HMAC-SHA256 in X-Meshbox-Signature, with three retries.
adm_webhook_url_invalid: Each webhook needs a URL starting with http:// or https://.
adm_webhook_secret_hint: Empty on a new one = generated automatically.
adm_webhook_secret_audit: Viewing the secret is recorded in the audit log.
adm_mqtt_alert_desc: Publishes each alert to meshbox/events/alert (for integrations).
adm_alert_stats: Since startup: {fired} alerts, {resolved} resolved, {ok} notices sent and {failed} failed.
adm_site_accent_hint: As #RRGGBB. Text on the accent is chosen automatically to stay readable.
adm_logo_hint: PNG or WebP up to 512 KB, square (SVG is not accepted for security).
adm_logo_too_big: The file is larger than 512 KB.
adm_logo_format: Upload a PNG or a WebP.
adm_site_map_desc: Initial view of the site: center, zoom and bounds (a node page may go outside them).
adm_site_bounds_hint: West, south, east, north (picked on the map).
adm_site_satellite_hint: Esri imagery, requested by each visitor's browser.
adm_site_thresholds_desc: Minutes without hearing a node to go from active to recent, recent to late and late to inactive.
adm_site_thresholds_invalid: Each threshold must be greater than or equal to the previous one.
adm_site_notice_desc: Shown in About. The server turns it into blocks: HTML is never published.
adm_tiles_desc: Vector tiles of the region (Protomaps) served by this device: light and dark maps without third parties.
adm_tiles_map: Map to pick the extract box
adm_tiles_box_hint: Move the map and use the view as the box.
adm_tiles_box_invalid: Pick a box up to about 5° × 5°.
adm_tiles_maxzoom_hint: 14 is enough for streets; each extra level nearly quadruples the size.
adm_tiles_source_hint: Empty = the latest Protomaps daily build.
adm_tiles_delete_desc: The site goes back to the satellite layer (or just the background if satellite is disabled).
adm_privacy_ignore_mqtt_hint: Drops what other gateways upload to the Internet: only what is heard over the radio stays.
adm_privacy_as_received_hint: Each owner chooses the precision on their node.
adm_privacy_degrade_hint: Positions are rounded before being stored and published.
adm_retention_desc: Days each type of data is kept. Cleanup runs every day at 03:30.
adm_ret_radio_messages: Meshtastic client messages (all channels and direct)
adm_purge_now_desc: Applies the retention right away and deletes the history of hidden nodes.
adm_purge_now_confirm: Data past retention and the history of hidden nodes are deleted. This cannot be undone.
adm_privacy_notice_where: The privacy notice is edited in
adm_user_disabled_hint: Cannot sign in and their sessions are closed.
adm_user_must_change_toggle: Require a password change at sign-in
adm_user_pw_keep: Empty = unchanged. Changing it closes their sessions.
adm_user_delete_desc: They lose access to the panel. Their actions stay in the audit log.
adm_role_operator_hint: Dashboard, packets, nodes, messages, alerts and logs.
adm_role_admin_hint: The whole panel, including network, users and updates.
adm_session_close_desc: That person has to sign in again.
adm_session_close_current: It is this very session: you will have to sign in again afterwards.
adm_sessions_desc: Every open panel session, with its IP and browser.
adm_audit_filter_hint: For example node., user., backup. or auth.
adm_pw_desc: The other sessions of this user are closed.
adm_pw_new_hint: At least 8 characters, without the username. A long phrase is better.
adm_pw_mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
adm_backups_desc: Current database: {size}. A daily backup runs automatically; more can be created manually.
adm_restore_desc: Replaces all current data (nodes, messages, settings and users) with the backup. A safety copy is saved first; reception stops for a few seconds.
adm_upload_restore_desc: A .db.gz backup from this or another meshbox device (up to 512 MB).
adm_export_desc: config.toml, site settings, channels, alert rules, MQTT accounts and plugins, as JSON.
adm_export_secrets_hint: Channel keys, tokens and passwords, encrypted with AES-256-GCM and the password below.
adm_export_password_hint: At least 10 characters. Without it the export cannot be imported with secrets.
adm_export_password_short: The password must have at least 10 characters.
adm_import_desc: Replaces settings, channels and rules. This device's paths, ports and mode are kept.
adm_import_confirm: The current settings, channels and alert rules are replaced.
adm_import_done_restart: Configuration imported. Restarting meshbox is recommended (Dashboard → Services).
adm_import_not_json: The file is not valid JSON.
adm_import_not_meshbox: The file is not a meshbox export.
adm_update_restarting: meshbox is restarting with the new version; the page reloads by itself.
adm_update_rollback_desc: The previous version is reinstalled and the database from before the update is restored. The service restarts.
adm_update_auto: Check for new versions every week
adm_update_auto_hint: It only notifies: it never installs by itself.
adm_update_none: No versions found (or the source cannot be reached).
adm_update_install_desc: privd downloads the package, verifies the Ed25519 signature, backs up the database and restarts meshbox. The site goes down briefly.
adm_cf_public_host_hint: The one set up in Cloudflare (to show and test it).
adm_cf_setup_desc: With a tunnel no router ports have to be opened. Token mode is the simplest; API mode creates everything by itself.
adm_cf_token_step1: In Cloudflare Zero Trust → Networks → Tunnels, create a cloudflared tunnel.
adm_cf_token_step2: Add a public hostname pointing to {target} (not localhost).
adm_cf_token_step3: Copy the token from the install command and paste it here.
adm_cf_tunnel_token_hint: The long string starting with eyJ…; privd stores it.
adm_cf_api_step1: Create an API token with Account → Cloudflare Tunnel: Edit, Zone → DNS: Edit and Zone → Zone: Read (plus Access: Apps and Policies: Edit for remote administration).
adm_cf_api_step2: Paste it here: it is verified, the domains are listed and the hostname is chosen.
adm_cf_api_token_hint: It is stored in the device secrets.
adm_cf_admin_sub_hint: To reach the panel from outside home, protected with Access.
adm_cf_replace_dns_hint: If the hostname already exists in DNS, it is overwritten.
adm_cf_restart_admin: To start the remote admin server, restart meshbox (Dashboard → Services) and set up Access.
adm_cf_access_desc: Creates an Access application for {host} that only lets these emails in (Cloudflare email code).
adm_cf_access_done: Access set up ({team}). Restart meshbox to start the remote server.
adm_cf_disconnect_desc: Stops the tunnel and deletes its token from the device: the site stops being published.
adm_cf_disconnect_confirm: The site stops being published on the Internet. It keeps working on the local network.
adm_cf_delete_tunnel: Also delete the tunnel in Cloudflare
adm_metrics_desc: Device resources and the state of the write queue, event bus and deduplication.
adm_shared_explain: Shared device: the network, WiFi, hotspot and hostname are managed by the host system (ADR 0004). They are shown here but changed from the operating system.
adm_net_hotspot_on_desc: The device leaves the current WiFi network and creates its own (meshbox-XXXX). Anyone connected over WiFi loses the panel until they join that network.
adm_net_hotspot_off_desc: The device reconnects to the saved WiFi network. Anyone on the hotspot loses the connection.
adm_net_hostname_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (up to 63). On the local network it is reached as name.local.
adm_net_hostname_desc: The name.local address changes: links and bookmarks with the old name stop working.
adm_net_forget_desc: The saved password is deleted: the device will not reconnect to that network by itself.
adm_net_connect_desc: privd tries the new network and, if it cannot connect, goes back to the previous one.
adm_net_connect_warn: The connection with this panel may be lost during the change. If the new network fails, the device goes back to the previous one within 2 minutes; if it works, the panel will be at the IP that network assigns.
adm_net_connect_ack: Confirmed: the connection with the panel may drop
adm_net_connecting: Connecting to {ssid}… If the panel stops responding, look for it on the new network.
adm_net_ntp_warn: The time is not synchronized yet. Without a backup clock, the Pi boots with an old time until it has Internet, and packets received meanwhile may get wrong dates.
adm_net_tz_hint: Used for dates, daily summaries and also as the system time zone.
adm_net_tz_shared: Used for dates and daily summaries. The system time zone is managed by the host.
adm_power_desc: Restarts or shuts down the whole Raspberry Pi. To turn it on after a shutdown, the power has to be unplugged and plugged in again.
adm_power_shared: Shared device: restarting or shutting down also stops the other services running on it (for example, other servers).
adm_reboot_desc: The site, the panel and packet reception stop for about a minute.
adm_shutdown_desc: The device stays off until the power is unplugged and plugged back in: it cannot be turned on from the panel.
adm_reboot_done: Restart in progress. The page should respond again in about a minute.
adm_shutdown_done: Shutting down. The device turns off in a few seconds.
adm_admins_only: This section is only for administrator accounts.
adm_tx_disabled: Transmission is disabled on this device. It is enabled with [tx] enabled = true in config.toml.
adm_log_live_only_meshbox: Live only for meshbox; the other services refresh with Apply.
adm_log_empty: No log entries with these filters.
adm_plugin_logs_desc: The last 300 lines since the plugin started, newest first.
adm_plugin_logs_empty: No logs (the plugin is not running or has not written anything yet).
adm_plugin_enable_desc: It is a third-party plugin: it runs inside the service with these permissions, so enabling it means trusting its code.
adm_perm_events_read: Read network events (packets, nodes and messages)
adm_perm_map_layers: Add layers to the public map
adm_tx_intro: Transmission uses the node connected over USB or the network, with its name. Limit: 1 send every 30 seconds and 20 per hour. Every send is recorded in the audit log.
adm_tx_usb_state: The connector {id} is {state}: transmitting is not possible until it connects.
adm_tx_no_usb: There is no USB or TCP connector configured: transmitting requires a node connected over USB or the network.
adm_tx_wait: Transmission limit: the next send is enabled in {seconds} s.
adm_tx_text_desc: Sent to every node on the chosen channel.
adm_tx_trace_desc: Requests the route to a node. The reply arrives as TRACEROUTE_APP and shows up in Packets and on the map.
adm_step_fallback: falling back to the previous network
setup_window_closes: Without users, the wizard stays open until {time} (60 min after boot).
setup_closed_desc: More than 60 minutes passed since boot without creating the administrator. To reopen it, restart the device (unplug and plug it back in) and open this page again.
setup_login_desc: The administrator already exists: the rest of the wizard continues with its session.
setup_already_title: The device is already set up
setup_already_desc: Everything can be changed from the panel. The wizard can be walked through again to review the steps.
setup_wifi_desc: The device is in hotspot mode. First it joins the home WiFi network; the rest of the wizard continues from that network.
setup_wifi_before: Before connecting, note how to continue:
setup_wifi_how_1: On connecting, the hotspot turns off and this page stops responding.
setup_wifi_how_2: Switch the phone back to the home WiFi network.
setup_wifi_how_3: Open http://meshbox.local/setup. If it does not open (common on several Android phones), look for the «meshbox» device in the router's device list or open the address from a PC.
setup_wifi_how_4: If the connection fails, the hotspot comes back by itself within 2 minutes and it can be retried.
setup_wifi_fallback: This page stops responding in a few seconds: that is expected.
setup_code_desc: While no user exists, the wizard asks for this device's one-time code.
setup_code_hint: 8 characters. install.sh shows it when it finishes; in the image it is in /boot/firmware/meshbox-codigo.txt (removing the card or over SSH).
setup_locale_desc: The public site's default language (each visitor can change it) and the time zone for dates.
setup_admin_desc: There is no default password: this account signs in to the panel. More users can be created later.
setup_admin_user_hint: Lowercase letters, digits, dot and hyphen (3 to 32).
setup_admin_user_invalid: Invalid username: lowercase letters, digits, dot and hyphen, 3 to 32.
setup_admin_pw_hint: At least 8 characters, without the username. A long phrase is better.
setup_admin_pw_short: The password must have at least 8 characters.
setup_admin_pw_user: The password cannot contain the username.
setup_site_desc: Name and area of the public map: the center is set on the map and the bounds frame the network.
setup_site_slug_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It builds the MQTT root msh/AR/{slug}.
setup_site_slug_invalid: Only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (2 to 32).
setup_site_map_hint: The bounds can be adjusted later in Site and map; they are also used to suggest the base map download.
setup_radio_desc: How packets arrive: over USB, from a node plugged into this device (simplest), or over MQTT, from a WiFi Heltec somewhere else. You can use both.
setup_radio_mqtt_hint: Only if the node is somewhere else and connects over WiFi. Creates the gateway account and shows the commands to set it up.
setup_radio_gw_invalid: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphen and underscore (2 to 21).
setup_radio_usb: USB: node plugged into this device
setup_radio_usb_hint: With a data cable in the Pi's USB port. It also allows transmitting, if enabled.
setup_radio_no_ports: No ports detected: check the cable (it must carry data) and type the port by hand.
setup_radio_mqtt_ready: Heltec over WiFi (MQTT): account and commands
setup_channel_desc: The area network's channel. Its messages are shown on the site.
setup_channel_name_hint: The area's preset, for example LongFast or MediumFast (up to 11).
setup_channel_key_hint: AQ== is the Meshtastic default key.
setup_channel_note: Private channels (with another key) are added later in Channels and are not shown on the site.
setup_privacy_desc: What is published on the site and how precisely.
setup_privacy_ignore_mqtt: Ignore nodes that only arrive over MQTT
setup_privacy_ignore_mqtt_hint: Recommended: shows only the network heard over radio.
setup_privacy_as_received: As received (each node chooses its precision)
setup_privacy_notice_hint: Markdown. Shown in About; empty = the default notice.
setup_privacy_retention: How long each kind of data is kept is set later in Privacy and retention.
setup_tiles_desc: With an extract of the region stored on the device, the map works without internet. The download continues by itself in the background.
setup_tiles_note: Without an extract, the map uses the online service while there is internet.
setup_cf_desc: With a Cloudflare tunnel the site gets a public address without opening router ports.
setup_cf_point_1: A Cloudflare account with a domain of its own is needed.
setup_cf_point_2: Token mode is the simplest: the tunnel is created in Cloudflare and the token is pasted.
setup_cf_point_3: It can be done at any time from the panel's Cloudflare section.
setup_finish_desc: It checks that packets arrive and that the site responds. It refreshes by itself.
setup_finish_wait: If no packet has arrived yet it can still be finished: the Heltec may take a few minutes to restart and connect.
setup_check_packets_hint: With the Heltec set up and powered on, they show up within a minute or two.
setup_done_desc: The site is up and running. Everything can be adjusted from the panel.
adm_cli_no_boards: No boards connected over USB or the network. Add one as a connector in
adm_cli_not_connected: The board on connector {id} is {state}. It can't be queried or configured until it connects.
adm_cli_radio_tx_off: The board has radio transmit turned off (lora.tx_enabled): it can't send anything.
adm_cli_traffic_desc: What the board reports about itself (LocalStats): it arrives now and then with its telemetry.
adm_cli_no_stats: No traffic telemetry from this board yet.
adm_cli_pos_note: Without GPS, the firmware doesn't reload the fixed position at boot and stops sending the map report. meshbox sets it again once per board boot.
adm_cli_unfix_desc: The board stops reporting that location. Without GPS it will have no position until another one is set.
adm_cli_actions_desc: Rebooting drops the link for a few seconds and meshbox reconnects on its own. Once shut down, the board only comes back with its button or a power cycle.
adm_cli_reboot_desc: It reboots in 5 seconds. While starting it neither receives nor relays.
adm_cli_shutdown_desc: It shuts down in 5 seconds and won't come back by itself: someone has to press its button or cycle power. If it's up high or far away, it stays out of service.
adm_cli_shutting_down: The board shuts down in 5 seconds
adm_cli_lan_only: The board can't be shut down from the internet.
adm_cli_short_hint: 1 to 4 characters (shown on the map and on screens).
adm_cli_backup_note: A backup of the board's settings is made before saving (Backups tab).
adm_cli_saved_backup: Saved to the board (backup made first)
adm_cli_no_changes: No changes: the board already had those values
adm_cli_no_messages: No messages in this conversation yet.
adm_cli_public_warn: Public channel: anyone using the well-known key can read it, across the whole mesh.
adm_cli_confirm_channel: This is transmitted over the radio on # {name} under the board's name. Send?
adm_cli_confirm_dm: This is transmitted over the radio to {name}, encrypted for that node if it has a public key. Send?
adm_cli_trace_sent: Traceroute sent: the reply shows up in Packets and on the map
adm_cli_pos_answered: The node replied with its position
adm_cli_pos_no_answer: The node didn't reply in time (it may arrive later)
adm_cli_tx_note: Each action transmits over the radio: 1 every 30 seconds and 20 per hour.
adm_cli_no_tx: Transmitting requires an administrator, [tx] enabled and the board's radio turned on.
adm_cli_channels_intro: These are the board's channels, not meshbox's. Changing a channel's name or key cuts it off from everyone using it: those changes ask for confirmation twice.
adm_cli_remote_limits: You're connected from the internet: dangerous changes, deleting channels, shutting down and restoring backups are only allowed from the local network.
adm_cli_uplink_hint: What arrives on this channel is published to the board's MQTT server.
adm_cli_downlink_hint: What arrives from the MQTT server is transmitted over the radio on this channel. It opens a way to inject messages: enable it only if needed.
adm_cli_muted_hint: The board doesn't notify (sound or light) messages on this channel.
adm_cli_precision_hint: Bits the board uses to share its position on this channel: 0 doesn't share it, 13 ≈ 2.9 km, 16 ≈ 360 m, 32 exact.
adm_cli_primary_name_hint: Empty uses the preset name (like MediumFast). Changing it takes the board off the public channel.
adm_cli_channel_name_required: The new channel needs a name
adm_cli_delete_channel_desc: The board stops receiving and sending on that channel, and the following channels move up one slot. A backup is made first.
adm_cli_danger_desc: These changes can cut the board off from the mesh or make it unreachable from meshbox. A backup of the settings is saved before applying them.
adm_cli_danger_remote: Dangerous changes aren't allowed from the internet: make them from the local network.
adm_cli_danger_backup: If something goes wrong, restore the backup from the Backups tab (local network only).
adm_cli_config_intro: The board's full settings, section by section as in the app. Only what changed is saved, and fields marked as dangerous ask for confirmation twice.
adm_cli_section_readonly: This section can be viewed but not changed from the panel.
adm_cli_section_danger: Sensitive section: a mistake can leave the board without a network, without a link to meshbox or without keys.
adm_cli_backups_intro: A full backup of the settings (keys included) is saved before every change. The last 30 per board are kept. Restoring rewrites only what differs.
adm_cli_backups_remote: Downloading and restoring backups is only allowed from the local network: they contain the board's keys.
adm_cli_no_backups: No backups of this board yet.
adm_cli_restore_desc: Settings, channels and name that differ are rewritten. If any section changes, the board reboots once at the end. A backup of the current state is saved first.
adm_cli_restored: Backup restored: {sections} sections and {channels} channels written
adm_cli_reboot_note: Many changes reboot the board (the firmware decides: Display, Network or Region do; the hop limit doesn't). While it starts it doesn't receive, for about 30 seconds, and meshbox reconnects on its own.
adm_cli_history_note: History is kept on the device for {days} days (change it in Privacy and retention).
adm_cli_clear_desc: All saved messages of this board (channels and direct) and the read marks are deleted from the device. This can't be undone; the board and the mesh don't change.
adm_cli_share_none: On channel {channel} the board doesn't share its position (precision 0): it isn't shown on the map. Change it in Channels.
adm_cli_share_exact: On channel {channel} it shares its exact position.
adm_cli_share_approx: On channel {channel} it shares an approximate position (±{meters} m). To show it exactly on the map, set the channel precision to 32 (Channels).
adm_cli_fix_desc: Move the map (or tap a spot) until the marker sits on the board, or type the coordinates. The board keeps it as a fixed position and shares it on its next position broadcast.
adm_cli_geo_failed: Couldn't get your location (check the browser permission).
adm_cli_fix_invalid: Invalid position: pick it on the map or check the coordinates.
chart_zoom_hint: Drag over the chart to zoom into that span; double-click to see it all.
adm_cli_battery_101: Battery 101 % = the voltage went over 4.2 V and the charger (sun or USB) is holding it full. The board can't detect the panel: charging starts earlier, at sunrise, and until it reaches 4.2 V you only see the voltage rise.
adm_bat_recovers_text: It replaces what it uses: it reaches a full charge or the dawn minimum goes up.
adm_bat_stable_text: The dawn minimum holds: it replaces about what it uses, with little margin for cloudy days.
adm_bat_deficit_text: The dawn minimum drops {mv} mV per day: at this rate it reaches {volts} V (where the board reboots) in {days} days. The panel or charger falls short, or consumption is too high.
adm_bat_no_data_text: At least one full night of telemetry is needed.
adm_bat_evening_delta: End of day vs. the day before
adm_bat_since: The trend counts from {date}: before that the board was off for more than 6 hours (battery swap, move or outage). Earlier days are grayed out and not compared.
adm_bat_note: Dawn: minimum before it starts to rise. Full: hours with the charger holding the battery above 4.2 V (the board reports 101); less than an hour doesn't count as a full charge. End of day: voltage from 9 pm to midnight. The percentage comes from the voltage.
